name: glm53-quality-split-v1
purpose: Map #12/#15: qualify serve's Fast shared-prefix split (fast_shared_split_v1) as a Fast prefill schedule against Exact, with quality-v1's limits; analysed by scripts/reference/glm53/quality_split_analysis.py, fixed before any GPU run.
schedule: prefill [0, s) then [s, N), each in 512-row chunks from its own start (serve's miss; its hit restores at s and is bit-identical)

arms.exact_512: Exact, one prefill (full rerun; the reference)
arms.fast_split_grid: Fast split at the largest s < L with s mod 512 = the agent prefix's in-chunk offset
arms.fast_split_tail: Fast split at s = L - 17 - (document index mod 4)
arms.fast_split_frontier: long items only: Fast split at s = 2050 + (long-document index mod 4)
arms.tools: exact_512, fast_512, fast_split at each task's renderer-recorded shared-prefix end
arms.agent: exact (shared prefix prefilled once, restored per generation; checked once against an unsplit Exact prefill), fast_512 (unsplit), fast_split (shared prefix once, restored per generation: serve's hit)
